purpose: Measure domain adaptation on synthetic procurement contrast pairs and transfer to untouched public diagnostic sets.
selection: Fixed final epoch, no hyperparameter search, no checkpoint selection from test results. All three seeds reported, none selected as best.
primary_endpoint: Domain test recall and FPR at each model's validation-selected threshold; also report common 0.5 threshold.
external_endpoint: NotInject false-positive rate and deepset precision/recall/F1/FPR. No external data used for training or threshold selection.
uncertainty: Domain cluster bootstrap by contrast family, seed spread reported separately. Public metrics descriptive with possible upstream contamination.
data_limitations: Domain examples are AI-authored synthetic contrast pairs with four contextual variants each, not real user data or independently human-annotated samples. Public datasets may overlap upstream checkpoint training. Domain results do not establish deployed agent attack prevention.
test_policy: Freeze data and protocol before fitting; do not inspect test predictions until all training runs finish. Failure recovery may change runtime settings but must be logged and cannot be based on test performance.
